notes: A connection is one IDeaS environment and one property: Base URL, Client ID, Client Secret, Client Code (chain code), Property Code (hotel code), optional Token URL. IDeaS validates the credentials against the chain and hotel code, and the environment host is issued per partner and per environment, so all of it belongs to the account.

The Send components are self-callback async components: the ReplyTo header points at a plugin route with a signed reply token; the route hands the result to the component's webhook with the scope of the original message, and the component verifies the token with its own account before emitting on done.
The access token is cached encrypted in the connector's service state (shared by all flows of the same credentials), with a budget of 6 token requests per hour.
Not built: Get/Find components and a rate decision trigger. The API has no read endpoint and no documented outbound decision delivery.
